title: EventFrame
description:
A single SFWP event frame. `cursor` is the emitting ledger entry's
`entry_ulid` — monotonic in append order, durable, and replay-addressable.

committed_at.description: RFC3339 commit timestamp taken from the ledger entry.

cursor.description: Opaque durable cursor: the events-ledger `entry_ulid` for this event.
